evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (cargo test incl. tests/preparation_lifecycle.rs 3/3, bun, node, typecheck, gallery 164 passed)

notes:
Did: migration 20261025000600_phase3_claim_source_status.sql adds briefing_claims.status ('cited'|'source_unavailable', default cited). Claim gains status: ClaimStatus (serde 'cited'|'source_unavailable'), read for statements and questions. documents::repository::mark_deleted, in the same transaction that removes passages, sets status='source_unavailable' and quote='' on every claim citing any version of the document. StoredBriefing (prep_get_briefing) gains stale: bool, computed at read time: true when any document version in the briefing's manifest_json has a newer version of the same document (json_each over the manifest). The briefing and its claims are untouched on replace, so claims still name version 1 and its passages. New command documents_delete_impact(documentId) -> number (distinct briefings with a claim citing any version of the document; DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown id), registered in lib.rs; pub delete_impact(pool, id) and repository::citing_briefing_count. preparation-service.ts BriefingClaim.status and StoredBriefing.stale added. tests/preparation_lifecycle.rs (3 tests, TempDir db): replace -> stale, other plan's briefing not stale, claim still resolves to a v1 passage containing its quote; delete -> statements and questions citing it are source_unavailable with empty quote, a claim citing another document in the same briefing stays cited, TEXT-column scan finds none of the deleted text; impact counts 2 and 2; unknown id -> DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND. Both tests fail when the propagation UPDATE or the stale check is disabled (checked by hand).
Assumptions: on delete the model-written claim text and rationale are kept (the spec says remove the quote); only verbatim document text is scrubbed. Remove text/rationale too if the user wants paraphrases gone. A replace that produces a failed-extraction version also makes the briefing stale. Stale is derived on read, not stored, so it needs no write on replace; it covers any selected document in the manifest, cited or not. documents_delete_impact counts briefings with claims citing the document, not briefings whose manifest merely included it. Impact of an already deleted document still returns its count.
Learned: there is no TS wrapper for documents_delete_impact yet; the UI item that shows the delete confirmation should add deleteDocumentImpact to document-service.ts and stub documents_delete_impact in the gallery ipc. A fresh worktree needs bash .loop/init.sh before cargo test (llama-helper binary resource). Gallery passed first time (164).
